634:t_1:3.en:
???
「...But even this plan means nothing unless the dialogue to come is carried out. That's all there is to it.」

634:t_1:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「So he's the one who holds the key...」

634:t_1:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Thank you. Being able to talk with you like this was a great gain.」

634:t_1:7.en:
???
「I'm the one who should be thanking you. Your existence proves my reason for existing.」

634:t_1:8.en:
???
「And now that I've entrusted the entire plan to you, I intend to go to sleep deep within $$ヴェーダ$$.」

634:t_1:10.en:
???
「Your body and a $$ガンダム$$ have already been prepared. Ever since the $$サイデリアル$$ attacked Earth, I was sure this day would come.」

634:t_1:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「From start to finish, it was all in the palm of $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$'s hand...」

634:t_1:12.en:
???
「That may have been true until now, but from here on it won't be.」

634:t_1:14.en:
???
「I'll watch over your future together with $$ヴェーダ$$... $$ティエリア$$... you are to go on with them...」

634:t_1:15.en:
???
($$アムロ$$... The future I spoke of with you is almost here...)

634:t_1:22.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We gave him every treatment we possibly could, but...」

634:t_1:23.en:
$$シン$$
「What on earth happened to $$刹那$$?」

634:t_1:24.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$'s analysis says that when he tried to share consciousness with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, he couldn't take in all their data, and his brain cells were damaged.」

634:t_1:25.en:
$$キラ$$
「Is the consciousness of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ really so vast that a human can't contain it...?」

634:t_1:26.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We've done brain cell regeneration treatment, but there's a chance that his consciousness and memory will be impaired... is what they said...」

634:t_1:27.en:
$$アルト$$
「Letting the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ know that we mean no hostility... That might be the only way to end this battle, and yet...」

634:t_1:28.en:
$$葵$$
「This is no time for whining. Now that it's come to this, all we can do is stop them by force.」

634:t_1:29.en:
$$シン$$
「I hear the Federation is gathering every bit of strength it can to meet the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ head-on.」

634:t_1:30.en:
$n
「They reportedly secured $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s cooperation too, but how long can they hold out...」

634:t_1:31.en:
$$カレン$$
「Once we're resupplied, we'll be sortieing right away too...」

634:t_1:33.en:
$$葵$$
「It'll be okay, $$フェルト$$. We're $c, the ones who even drove back the $$新地球皇国$$.」

634:t_1:34.en:
$$アルト$$
「We'll do the fighting. $$フェルト$$, you stay by $$刹那$$'s side.」

634:t_1:35.en:
$n
($$刹那$$... You saved me when I was about to sink into despair. I refuse to believe you'll end in a place like this.)

634:t_1:36.en:
$$キラ$$
(You'll definitely come back... Until then, we'll manage somehow.)

634:t_1:40.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$刹那$$ will wake up for sure.」

634:t_1:42.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「He still has something left undone. He isn't the kind of person to just walk away from that.」

634:t_1:45.en:
$$レド$$
「I want to see how that turns out, too.」

634:t_1:47.en:
$$レド$$
「Because they aren't human... because words don't get through... If there's something beyond that, I want to know it.」

634:t_1:48.en:
$$レド$$
「Tell $$刹那$$ this: if he's going to show me that, I'll back him up with everything I have.」

634:t_1:49.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hang in there, $$フェルト$$. Keep calling out to $$刹那$$ the whole time.」

634:t_1:50.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Because I'm sure your voice will reach $$刹那$$.」

634:t_1:52.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, $$バサラ$$! You can't just start playing guitar out of nowhere!」

634:t_1:53.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You're so damn noisy about every little thing.」

634:t_1:55.en:
$$バサラ$$
「If that guy tells me I'm too loud, I'll quit right then.」

634:t_1:56.en:
$$バサラ$$
「But hey! His song set my heart on fire! That guy's got the same soul I do!」

634:t_1:58.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Sorry, $$フェルト$$. Playing right next to a patient.」

634:t_1:59.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But $$バサラ$$'s song might just wake $$刹那$$ up.」

634:t_1:61.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Can a song really do that!?」

634:t_1:62.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I've seen a song call someone in a coma back to consciousness myself.」

634:t_1:63.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Was it $$バサラ$$'s song that did it?」

634:t_1:64.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「No... The person in the coma was $$バサラ$$.」

634:t_1:65.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Your song back then, $$ガムリン$$... It was really wonderful.」

634:t_1:66.en:
$$レド$$
「$$バサラ$$ was brought back by Captain $$ガムリン$$'s song...」

634:t_1:67.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「A person's... no, it doesn't matter whether the listener is even a person, but what moves their heart isn't whether the song is good or bad.」

634:t_1:68.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's the strength of the feeling behind it.」

634:t_1:70.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「So do your best too, $$フェルト$$.」

634:t_1:71.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Throw your feelings at this guy.」

634:t_1:72.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Are you done already, $$バサラ$$?」

634:t_1:73.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I've delivered my soul. All $$刹那$$ has to do now is set his own on fire.」

634:t_1:75.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Then let's get going. I'm leaving $$刹那$$ to you, $$フェルト$$.」

634:t_1:77.en:
$$フェルト$$
(You're not alone... Because this many people are waiting for you.)

634:t_1:80.en:
$$グラハム$$
「He keeps searching for a path to mutual understanding, and tries to walk it even with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...」

634:t_1:82.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Carving out the future... So that is your fight, $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$...」

634:t_1:85.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I believe in you. That you will open your eyes.」
